thread.title: Nasdaq turns positive as Apple shares rise - MarketWatch

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: Nasdaq turns positive as Apple shares rise - MarketWatch
text:
10:25 a.m. ET Share Ryan Vlastelica Markets reporter
The Nasdaq Composite Index turned positive in morning trading on Tuesday, shaking off an early decline as shares in Apple rose to their highs of the session. The index COMP, +0.91% rose 0.1%, with Apple AAPL, +2.32% up 1.7%. The iPhone maker is scheduled to report its quarterly results after the market closes. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.27% fell 0.7% on Tuesday while the S&P 500 SPX, +0.25% lost 0.2%. The Dow was on track for its fourth straight daily decline. Among the factors weighing on stocks on Tuesday was construction spending, which fell 1.7% in March from February. Quote References
